descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S24 「记录的 prompt 和 Vikram 的原版逐字一致，Mistral 调用带和 Haiku 一样的 guardrail」 Note prompts match Vikram's original word for word, and Mistral calls carry the same guardrail as Haiku

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T3 The note prompts and templates are unchanged from Vikram's original except approved changes; any other wording change has Vikram's approval on record.（TFA-92592 AC 13；TFA-94229 AC 1；TFA-94229 R1；TFA-94229 R2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • T7 Mistral calls go through the same Bedrock guardrail as Haiku.（TFA-94422 AC 4）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Prompt library on main (note/clinical-quality 1.7, note/patient-context, note/snf-patient-context, templates soap, hp, consult, discharge, snf-progress, snf-admission) and prompts.lock.json; prototype RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html; convex/ai/providers/bedrock.ts

When Diff each note prompt against the prototype (whitespace-normalised) and list every difference with its approval; read the Bedrock call path for Haiku and Mistral

Then Every difference is an approved change (TFA-92592 AC 6/7/10/16 fixes, the #100 EARLIER VALUES block); the same guardrailConfig (id and version) is sent for both models

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Doc review. #100's wording has not been reviewed by Vikram yet (TFA-92592 AC 13 note), so any EARLIER VALUES text in the build is an unapproved difference until he signs off

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-14.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：code-review。
